description: Reorder, remove, duplicate or turn the pages of one PDF. Takes pdf files.

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

pages.description: The pages of the result, in order, e.g. `3,1-2,5-` or `1,2@90,2`. Empty: every page as it is.

remove.description: Pages of the input to leave out, e.g. `4,7-9`. Applied after `pages`.

rotate.description: Turn pages of the input clockwise, e.g. `2:90,5:180`: every copy of that page.

same_width.description: Scale pages wider than the narrowest down to its width.

name: pdf_pages
title: Organize pages
